_comments: Sets JSONType metadata on EntityRelationship.RelatedRecordCollection so CodeGen emits a
strongly-typed RelatedRecordCollectionObject accessor. The column declares a relationship as a
first-class related-record collection — the policy half of a DeclareRelatedRecords(...) call.
RelatedEntity and RelatedEntityJoinField are NOT part of the JSON shape: they are already
columns on the same row, and duplicating them would create two sources of truth.
RelatedRecordCollection — Name, Load, OnRemove, OrderBy, Sequence, ClearAfterSave
